remarks: Gracious Milbrook Association Center Hall Colonial with classic white pillars welcomes you to this grand home infused with Southern elegance. The foyer opens to a step-down living room featuring original coffered extra-height ceilings, wood burning fireplace and French doors leading to a stone terrace. This lovely home boasts a large formal dining room, 6 bedrooms and 3.1 baths and on the 2nd floor a Primary ensuite bedroom with balcony. Additional features include attached 2 car garage, walk-up attic and cedar closet. Situated on a corner lot of .52 acres, the property is conveniently located near the Milbrook Club, schools, Greenwich Ave. and train station. There are endless possibilities for updates and renovations. Customize the spacious interior to suit your personal style.
